text:
Leo (oncall): :rotating_light: incident-bot triggered: elevated 429s and rising p95 for eu-west routing layer. Opening thread to coordinate live mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1210 created. Symptom: progressive 429 spikes from routing -> runtime for eu-west. Impact: increased client retries and degraded throughput on hosted generation routes. Severity: SEV-2.

Tess (SRE): I'm on it. Metrics show routing queue depth increasing and then 429 bursts as backpressure propagates. Root signals point to a mismatch between routing concurrency and backend worker capacity after an uneven scale event ~10m ago. No code deploys.

Arjun (runtime): I can see a few runtime instances with exceptionally high latency due to KV cache thrash; memory pressure visible on runtime hosts eu-runtime-07 and eu-runtime-11. If we can divert a portion of traffic to eu-runtime-13 (healthy) and temporarily raise routing retry budget, we can reduce 429s.

Zoe (infra): I'll open a quick burst capacity window and cordon eu-runtime-11 for investigation. Commanding now: 

```
rctl infra scale --pool pool-gpu-eu-west --replicas +2 --reason "SEV-2 routing backpressure"
rctl node cordon eu-runtime-11 --reason "investigate mem pressure - incident INC-2026-1210"
```

Leo (oncall): Maya, please prepare a short customer-facing note. Keep it calm, say we're investigating and may see retries/timeouts. ETA for next update: 20m.

Maya (CS): Draft: "We're investigating intermittent 4xx/429 responses when calling generation endpoints in the EU region. Our engineers are applying mitigations and you may see brief retries or delays. We'll provide another update in 20 minutes."

Tess (SRE): Implementing short-term routing rules to shift 30% of new sessions to eu-runtime-13 and enabling a grace window for retries at the gateway. Also lowering default concurrency per routing worker to ease pressure while scale completes.

Arjun (runtime): Executed a fast restart of the model worker on eu-runtime-07 to clear KV cache; memory usage dropped and p95 on that host improved. eu-runtime-11 still cordoned for heap dump.

Leo (oncall): Good. Ops-pager, update PD with the mitigation steps and link to traces.

ops-pager: PD updated with checkpoint and trace links. Escalated to infra lead for further allocation review.

Tess (SRE): Quick status page draft for review: "Investigating elevated 429s and increased latency for EU inference. Engineers are applying traffic redistribution and scaling up capacity. Some customers may see retries or reduced throughput; next update in 20 minutes."

Leo (oncall): :thumbsup: Post it once Arjun confirms runtime stability.

Arjun (runtime): Runtime markers: after restart and traffic shift p95 across eu pool dropped from ~1.4s -> ~460ms; 429 rate decreased ~85%. Scaling completed: +2 replicas online.

Maya (CS): Sending the customer note to impacted accounts and monitoring inbound tickets. Will escalate if we get priority customers pinging.

Zoe (infra): I uploaded the heap dump and kernel logs from eu-runtime-11 to the incident ticket. Indications of a rare GC stall coupled with sudden spike in batch memory usage; preserving artifacts for postmortem.

Tess (SRE): I'm adding a temporary alert to catch routing queue depth > 600 for more than 90s so we get earlier warning of this pattern. Also adding a dashboard panel showing per-runtime p95 + queue depth correlation.

Leo (oncall): Handoff planning: I'm due to hand off in 35m. Can someone prepare a short bridge summary? Also pick postmortem owner.

Arjun (runtime): Bridge summary: "SEV-2 elevated 429s in eu-west caused by backend memory pressure and KV cache thrash on two runtime hosts; mitigations: restarted affected worker, cordoned host for analysis, scaled pool +2, shifted 30% traffic to healthy runtime, adjusted routing concurrency. Current: p95 ~460ms, 429 rate low. Follow-ups: investigate GC pattern, add early queue alerts, review autoscaler behavior for uneven scale events."

Zoe (infra): I'll co-own the postmortem with Arjun. Maya will handle customer timeline.

Leo (oncall): Ops-pager, link heap dump and traces to PD and note owners. If stable for 30m we'll mark mitigated.

ops-pager: Linked artifacts and assigned owners in PD incident. Noted mitigation timeline.

Maya (CS): One customer replied asking if retries could cause duplicate charges. I told them retries are idempotent for our billing and provided link to retry semantics in docs.

Tess (SRE): Adding a short runbook task: when routing 429s spike, first check per-host memory and queue depth, then shift traffic and scale; avoid immediate large-scale rollouts during high churn windows. I'll add that to the runbook PR.

Arjun (runtime): For completeness, commands we ran: 

```
# restart worker on eu-runtime-07
rctl runtime restart --node eu-runtime-07 --service model-worker --grace 10s
# set routing diversion
rctl routing split --route hosted.gen --region eu-west --weights eu-runtime-13:30,eu-runtime-07:35,eu-runtime-09:35 --reason "incident diversion"
```

Leo (oncall): Posting status page now.

incident-bot: Status posted to status.redwood.com: "Investigating 102 Elevated 429s and latency in EU region; mitigation in progress. Next update in 20 minutes."

Tess (SRE): Monitoring shows continued improvement; tokens/sec recovering and error budget stable. I'll keep the queue alert active for 1 hour.

Zoe (infra): Heap analysis notes in ticket: GC stall likely triggered by specific workload pattern with large batch sizes; disk/memory healthy otherwise. We'll reproduce in staging with similar batch shapes.

Leo (oncall): Handoff checklist for next oncall: 1) monitor routing queue and 429s for 1 hour, 2) confirm eu-runtime-11 analysis attached and reproduction attempts in staging, 3) review runbook PR and merge if clear, 4) coordinate customer follow-up.

Maya (CS): Customer notifications sent. No escalations so far; one customer acknowledged and thanked us for the quick update.

Arjun (runtime): I've scheduled a targeted replay in staging to reproduce the KV thrash: job id replay-449. Will post results in the incident ticket.

Tess (SRE): Agreed follow-ups: add early-queue alert, add per-runtime memory trendline to dashboard, add a safety cap to routing concurrency during scale events, and include a section in runbook for sticky traffic shifts.

Leo (oncall): Thanks team. If no regressions I'll mark this MITIGATED after the monitoring window. Handing off in 30m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1210 status updated to MITIGATED by Leo (oncall). Duration: ~56 minutes.

ops-pager: PD updated with mitigation summary, artifacts, and owner assignments.

Zoe (infra): Leaving an overnight note: we'll schedule a deeper autoscaler policy review and a staging replay to validate fixes. :coffee:
